title: WellaPath Nigeria facilities artifact — schema 2.0 (candidate)
description:
Schema for the nationwide facilities candidate. Additive over schema 1.0: every field facilities 1.1 emitted is still present under the same name and type, so the Mobile consumer's field access is unchanged. Two of those fields — type and emergency_capable — are null on every record because this source evidences neither; that is a behavioural change for the consumer even though the shape is unchanged, and it is the reason the artifact version is 2.0 rather than 1.2.

Absence convention, applied throughout: null means NOT PROVIDED (the source field was blank or a placeholder token). The literal string "unknown" means the source explicitly recorded Unknown, which is a different statement. No absent value is ever represented as false, zero or an invented value.

release_status.description: Pinned. A candidate becomes something else only through a recorded approval, never through regenerating it.

may_publish.description: Pinned false. Licence for this source is not established, which is a blocking gate independent of any technical readiness.

states_absent.description: States with no record at all. Present and non-empty for this candidate; the artifact states its own coverage gap rather than leaving a reader to discover it.

organization.description: Null, not a guess. The source file names no publishing organisation anywhere.

licence.description: Null, not a guess. No licence accompanied the data.

facility_id.description: Stable identity, derived from the source's own unique row id. Distinct in shape from facilities 1.1's ng_<state>_<n> ids so the two lineages can never be confused for one another.

type.description: Null on every record, deliberately. Mobile filters non-emergency results by type against {hospital, clinic, health_centre, pharmacy}; this source has no such column, only facility_level, which is a tier of care rather than a kind of facility. The mapping is a Product decision because it determines which facilities a user is shown for self-care versus urgent care.

city_area.description: The LGA name. facilities 1.1 populated this field with a mixture of LGA names and free text, so an LGA is consistent with its dominant existing use, not a change of meaning.

phone.description: E.164, normalised from the source and never invented. Null when the source value was absent, malformed or a placeholder. Public-use intent is NOT established; see the provenance record.

emergency_capable.description: Null on every record. facilities 1.1 derived this from type == 'hospital'; this source has no type, and none of its 90 columns records emergency capability.

services.description: Null means the source said neither Yes nor No. It is never coerced to false: 'we do not know whether this clinic has an ambulance' and 'this clinic has no ambulance' are different statements, and only one of them is safe to show a user.

source_record.description: Identity only. Every original value stays recoverable by joining source_id against the committed, hash-pinned source CSV.
